create or alter procedure [bulkload].[GetLoadColumns] @action varchar(2), @type varchar(50), @id int, @getLookups bit = 1 as begin declare @GroupActionLookupIDIdentifier int = 1001; declare @UserStatusLookupIDIdentifier int = 1002; declare @ResponsibilityLookupIDIdentifier int = 1003; declare @UserEmailGroupdisplayValueLookupIDIdentifier int = 1004; declare @ParentTypeNameLookupIDIdentifier int = 1005; declare @TagActionLookupIDIdentifier int = 1006;
declare @fields table (ID int identity, FieldTypeID int, Name nvarchar(250), [Required] bit, PartOfKey bit, AllowMultipleValues bit, IsLookup bit, [Level] int,LookUpID int default 0, index ix1_tmp_fields (fieldtypeid,lookupid)) declare @lookups table ([Value] uniqueidentifier, FieldTypeID int, [Label] nvarchar(max),LookUpID int default 0, index ix1_tmp_lookups (fieldtypeid,lookupid)) declare @current int = 1, @max int, @isLookup bit = 0, @fieldTypeID int
declare @fieldType table (ID int INDEX IX2 NONCLUSTERED) declare @assettypeid int;
if @type = 'IntersectType' begin insert into @fieldType select id from fieldtype where intersecttypeid = @id; end else if @type = 'IntersectType' begin insert into @fieldType select id from fieldtype where issuetypeid = @id; end else begin select @assettypeid = id from assettype att where att.object = @type and att.objectid = @id;
insert into @fieldType select id from fieldtype ft where assettypeid = @assettypeid; end
if @action = 'M' begin if @id = 0 begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level],LookUpID) values (1, 'Action', 1, 0, 0, 1, 1,@GroupActionLookupIDIdentifier) insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'Group Name', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'User Email', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1)
insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label],LookUpID) values (1, 'Add',@GroupActionLookupIDIdentifier) insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label],LookUpID) values (1, 'Remove',@GroupActionLookupIDIdentifier) end
if @id = 1 begin set @type = 'ResourceType'
insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level],LookUpID) values (1, 'Status', 1, 1, 0, 1, 1, @UserStatusLookupIDIdentifier) insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'User Email', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'First Name', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'Last Name', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1)
insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label],LookUpID) values (1, 'Active', @UserStatusLookupIDIdentifier) insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label],LookUpID) values (1, 'Inactive', @UserStatusLookupIDIdentifier) end end
if @action = 'O' begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level], LookUpID) values (1, 'Responsibility', 1, 1, 0, 1, 1, @ResponsibilityLookupIDIdentifier)
insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label], LookUpID) select 1, Name, @ResponsibilityLookupIDIdentifier from ResponsibilityType order by Name
insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level], LookUpID) values (2, 'Resource', 1, 1, 0, 1, 1, @UserEmailGroupdisplayValueLookupIDIdentifier)
insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label], LookUpID) select 2, 'User:' + email, @UserEmailGroupdisplayValueLookupIDIdentifier from reporting.Global_Resource order by email
insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label], LookUpID) select 2, 'Group:' + DisplayValue, @UserEmailGroupdisplayValueLookupIDIdentifier from AssetDetail A where A.Object = 'Group' order by DisplayValue
insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'Asset UID', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1); end
if @action = 'P' begin if @type = 'IntersectType' begin declare @sc int, @sid int, @oc int, @oid int
select @sc = SubjectClass, @sid = SubjectAssetTypeID, @oc = ObjectClass, @oid = ObjectAssetTypeID from IntersectType where ID = @id
if @sc = 2 -- Model begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'Subject Path', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end else begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level], LookUpID) select ID, 'Subject ' + Name, IsRequired, IsPartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, case [Type] when 'Lookup' then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as IsLookup, 1, case [Type] when 'Lookup' then ID else 0 end as LookUpID from FieldType where IsPartOfKey = 1 and AssetTypeID = @sid end
if @oc = 2 -- Model begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, 'Object Path', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end else begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level], LookUpID) select ID, 'Object ' + Name, IsRequired, IsPartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, case [Type] when 'Lookup' then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as IsLookup, 1, case [Type] when 'Lookup' then ID else 0 end as LookUpID from FieldType where IsPartOfKey = 1 and AssetTypeID = @oid end
end
if @type = 'ArtifactType' or @type = 'ReferenceItemType' begin declare @parentTypeID int = null, @parentTypeName nvarchar(250) = null
select @parentTypeID = I.SubjectAssetTypeID, @parentTypeName = I.SubjectName from IntersectTypeDetail I where I.ObjectAssetTypeID = @assettypeid and I.[PredicateType] = 3;
if @type = 'ReferenceItemType' begin set @parentTypeName = (select top 1 [Name] from AssetType where ID = @parentTypeID) end
if @parentTypeID is not null begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level], LookUpID) values(0, @parentTypeName, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1, @ParentTypeNameLookupIDIdentifier);
if @type = 'ArtifactType' begin insert into @lookups ([Value], FieldTypeID, [Label], LookUpID) select [uid], 0, DisplayValue, @ParentTypeNameLookupIDIdentifier from AssetDetail where AssetTypeID = @parentTypeID and [AssetTypeClass] in (1, 8) order by DisplayValue; end
if @type = 'ReferenceItemType' begin insert into @lookups ([Value], FieldTypeID, [Label], LookUpID) select [uid], 0, DisplayValue, @ParentTypeNameLookupIDIdentifier from AssetDetail where AssetTypeID = @parentTypeID and [AssetTypeClass] in (9) order by DisplayValue; end end end
if @type = 'ReferenceItemType' begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (-1, 'Code', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end
if @type = 'TaxonomyType' begin declare @initialDepth int = 1, @maxDepth int = 1 Select @maxDepth = HierarchyMaximumDepth from AssetType where object='TaxonomyType' and objectId = @id declare @levels table (Value int) while @initialDepth <= @maxDepth begin insert into @levels values (@initialDepth) set @initialDepth = @initialDepth + 1 end
insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level], LookUpID) select FT.ID, case when TTL.Name is not null then TTL.Name + ' ' + FT.Name else 'Level ' + cast(L.Value as nvarchar) + ' ' + FT.Name end, FT.IsRequired, FT.IsPartOfKey, FT.AllowMultipleValues, case FT.Type when 'Lookup' then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as IsLookup, L.Value as [Level], case FT.Type when 'Lookup' then FT.ID else 0 end as LookUpID from @levels L inner join FieldType FT on FT.IsPartOfKey = 1 and FT.AssetTypeID = @assettypeid left join AssetTypeLevel TTL on TTL.[Level] = L.Value and TTL.AssetTypeID = FT.AssetTypeID end end
if (@action = 'R' or @action = 'U') begin
print 'relate / unrelate'
declare @subjectClass int, @subjectTypeName nvarchar(500), @subjectTypeID int, @objectClass int, @objectTypeName nvarchar(500), @objectTypeID int
select @subjectClass = SubjectClass, @subjectTypeName = SubjectName, @subjectTypeID = SubjectAssetTypeID, @objectTypeName = ObjectName, @objectClass = ObjectClass, @objectTypeID = ObjectAssetTypeID from IntersectTypeDetail where ID = @id
if @objectClass = 9 and @objectTypeID = 0 begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, @objectTypeName + ' Asset Type Uid', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end else begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, @objectTypeName + ' Asset Uid', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end
if @subjectClass = 9 and @subjectTypeID = 0 begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, @subjectTypeName + ' Asset Type Uid', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end else begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level]) values (0, @subjectTypeName + ' Asset Uid', 1, 1, 0, 0, 1) end end
if ((@action = 'M' and @id = 1 ) or @action = 'R' or @action = 'P') begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level], LookUpID) select ft.ID, ft.Name, ft.IsRequired, ft.IsPartOfKey, ft.AllowMultipleValues, case ft.Type when 'Lookup' then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as IsLookup, 1, case ft.Type when 'Lookup' then ft.ID else 0 end as LookUpID from FieldType ft inner join @fieldType f on ft.id = f.id where ft.Type not in ('ComplexRelationLookup', 'FieldFromRelationship', 'OwnershipLookup', 'RefListRelationship', 'Tag', 'Relationship') and ( (@type = 'IntersectType' and ft.IsPartOfKey = 0) OR (@type = 'TaxonomyType' and ft.IsPartOfKey = 0) OR (@type <> 'TaxonomyType') ) and (ft.IsEditable = 1 or (@action = 'P' and ft.[Type] = 'JSON') or (ft.IsEditable = 0 and ft.IsRequired = 1)) order by ft.ColumnOrder;
--add Tag and Tag Action columns if applicable if exists (select 1 from FieldType ft inner join @fieldtype f on ft.id = f.id where ft.Type = 'Tag' and @action = 'P') begin insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level], [LookUpID]) select ft.ID, ft.Name, ft.IsRequired, ft.IsPartOfKey, ft.AllowMultipleValues, case ft.Type when 'Lookup' then cast(1 as bit) else cast(0 as bit) end as IsLookup, 1, case ft.Type when 'Lookup' then ft.ID else 0 end LookUpID from FieldType ft inner join @fieldtype f on ft.id = f.id where ft.Type = 'Tag' and @action = 'P'
insert into @fields (FieldTypeID, Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, [Level], [LookUpID]) values (0, 'Tag Action', 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, @TagActionLookupIDIdentifier);
insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label], [LookUpID]) values (0, 'Append', @TagActionLookupIDIdentifier); insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label], [LookUpID]) values (0, 'Replace', @TagActionLookupIDIdentifier);
end
declare @IDs varchar(500); select @IDs = string_agg(FieldTypeID, ',') from @fields where FieldTypeID <> 0 and IsLookup = 1 if @IDs IS NOT NULL begin insert into @lookups (FieldTypeID, [Label], [LookUpID]) exec('select FieldTypeID, [Text], [FieldTypeID] [LookUpID] from FieldLookupValue where FieldTypeID in (' + @IDs + ') order by FieldTypeID, [Text]'); end end
select Name, [Required], PartOfKey, AllowMultipleValues, IsLookup, F.[FieldTypeId], F.[Level], ( select L.Value, L.Label from @lookups L where L.FieldTypeID = F.FieldTypeID and L.lookupid = F.lookupid order by Label for json path ) as Lookups from @fields F for json path end
changeSet.rollback:

if @type = 'ArtifactType' or @type = 'ReferenceItemType' begin declare @parentTypeID int = null, @parentTypeName nvarchar(250) = null
